brief: A fresh identity for an extension used by international students: professional but playful, bold but relaxed, simple enough for Chrome and recognizable in the project README.
criteria: One recognisable silhouette; clear at 16–32 px; honest, neutral branding that never implies guaranteed sponsorship or official approval.

concepts.name: Between
concepts.idea: Two opposing quotation forms leave room to see what the posting actually says.
rationale: Keeps the chosen C silhouette and gives it warm, calm colour.
Custom SNS letters echo the mark's curved corners and cut terminals.
A simplified small cut and high-contrast icon tile support browser use.

recommendation: Ember on light surfaces; apricot and paper on ink for dark surfaces. Use the symbol alone in Chrome and the horizontal SNS lockup in the README.
next_steps: Review the colour and lockups; existing Chrome and README branding is unchanged.
After approval, integrate the prepared 16/32/48/128 px assets and README treatment.
Complete trademark and reverse-image clearance before public launch.
